admin_listen.description: Administration listen address. Keep this on loopback or a private network.

admin_token_env.description: Environment variable containing the admin bearer credential.

default_model_access_group.description: Group assigned to newly created users when no group is specified.

max_body_bytes.description: Maximum inference request body size in bytes.

max_response_bytes.description: Maximum upstream response size in bytes.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens allowed per inference request. Zero disables the gateway cap and leaves omitted request limits unset; positive values are inserted as max_tokens when no request limit is supplied.

global_concurrency.description: Maximum active inference requests across all users.

user_concurrency.description: Maximum active inference requests per user.

user_requests_per_minute.description: Maximum inference requests per minute per user.

request_timeout_seconds.description: Overall upstream request timeout in seconds.

header_timeout_seconds.description: Upstream response header timeout in seconds.

stream_idle_seconds.description: Maximum idle time between upstream stream events in seconds.

shutdown_seconds.description: Seconds to drain active requests during shutdown.

providers.description: Named upstream providers. Credentials reference environment variables.

models.description: Gateway model aliases mapped to upstream models.

model_access_groups.description: Explicit sets of gateway model aliases available to each group.

base_url.description: HTTPS API base URL without userinfo, query, or fragment.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable containing the provider API key.

input_usd_per_million.description: Flat USD price per million input tokens. Quote this decimal string; required for token_rates.

output_usd_per_million.description: Flat USD price per million output tokens. Quote this decimal string; required for token_rates.

pricing_version.description: Pricing version snapshotted for accounting; required for token_rates.

request_params.description: Operator-enforced upstream request fields. Each top-level field replaces the client value completely. Unknown upstream options are accepted; gateway-controlled fields are forbidden.

models.description: Allowed gateway model aliases. An empty array grants no model access.
